description: CSS and SCSS with the project's own .stylelintrc.json (stylelint-config-standard, one rule off); SCSS parses with postcss-scss although the config sets no SCSS syntax

notes.theme.scss#metrics: SCSS is language css without a grammar (report-format.md §6): no metrics, no duplication
notes.config: the project config turns font-family-no-missing-generic-family-keyword off, so Arial on line 12 is not reported; #fffffff is reported by declaration-property-value-no-unknown (stylelint 17 reports it there, not under color-no-invalid-hex)
notes.severity: report-format.md §7.1: rules of stylelint-config-recommended(-scss) are possible-error (reliability/medium), the others (length-zero-no-unit, color-hex-length, from stylelint-config-standard) convention (maintainability/low)
